title: SeaTalkNG Bus Failure
shortDescription: Axiom display has lost communication on the SeaTalkNG backbone.
fullDescription:
Raymarine's SeaTalkNG is a proprietary NMEA 2000 implementation. Error means the backbone has lost power, lost termination, or has a shorted drop cable.

Check the red power tap (one per backbone, never two), the two terminators (one at each end), and all drop cables for water intrusion.

Backbone resistance measured end-to-end with power off should be 60 ohms (two 120-ohm terminators in parallel).

causes.cause: Two power inputs on same backbone

fixSteps.title: Measure termination
fixSteps.instruction: Backbone end-to-end resistance should be 60 ohms.

fixSteps.title: Inspect connectors
fixSteps.instruction: Open each connector, check for water or corrosion.

whenToCallPro: If backbone routing is complex across large vessel.

faq.q: Can I mix SeaTalkNG and NMEA 2000?
faq.a: Yes with adapter cables — electrically identical.

title: Radar Scanner Not Detected
shortDescription: Axiom cannot connect to Quantum or Magnum radar.
fullDescription:
Raymarine Quantum radar uses Wi-Fi or RayNet Ethernet; Magnum uses Ethernet only. Offline status indicates power, network, or firmware mismatch.

On Quantum Wi-Fi: check pairing state in Axiom Settings > Radar. On wired: check RayNet cable and power breaker.

Quantum cold start takes ~30 sec; Magnum up to 90 sec — wait before diagnosing.

causes.cause: Radar breaker off or fuse blown
Firmware mismatch between scanner and display

fixSteps.title: Reset radar breaker
fixSteps.instruction: Cycle dedicated radar breaker for 30 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Check RayNet cable
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect and reseat at both ends.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Use LightHouse 4 via microSD to update Axiom and scanner.

whenToCallPro: If magnetron replacement needed on open-array radars.

faq.q: Is Quantum radar better than open array?
faq.a: Quantum is solid-state and CHIRP pulse — safer and clearer at short range; open array has longer maximum range.

title: Sonar Transducer Connectivity Fault
shortDescription: Axiom unable to detect RealVision 3D or CHIRP transducer.
fullDescription:
Axiom's internal sonar or external CP470/CP570 modules look for transducer handshake on startup. Connectivity fault means transducer is missing, cable damaged, or sonar module unpowered.

RealVision 3D uses a 25-pin Rayvision connector with multiple channels — any single pin failure can disable 3D mode but leave 2D working.

Route transducer cables away from engine harness — induced noise prevents handshake.

fixSteps.title: Check CP module
fixSteps.instruction: Verify power LED on external sonar module.

whenToCallPro: If thru-hull transducer needs replacement — requires haulout.

faq.a: Yes — if only 3D channel is damaged, 2D CHIRP still functions.

title: LightHouse Operating System Error
shortDescription: Axiom's LightHouse 3 or 4 OS has encountered a startup or runtime error.
fullDescription:
Axiom runs LightHouse OS (Linux-based). Errors during boot or runtime can cause reboot loops or freeze. Common fixes: power cycle, factory reset via settings, or OS reinstall from microSD.

Download latest LightHouse image from Raymarine website to a microSD card (FAT32) and insert during power-on to reinstall.

causes.cause: Corrupt OS install after interrupted update

fixSteps.title: Force shutdown
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power 10 seconds, wait 1 minute, retry.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall LightHouse
fixSteps.instruction: Download image from Raymarine to microSD, reinstall during boot.

whenToCallPro: If reinstall doesn't resolve — likely hardware, needs Raymarine service.

faq.a: Back them up first to an SD card via export menu.

title: Wind Vane Data Missing
shortDescription: Plotter not receiving wind data from masthead unit.
fullDescription:
Raymarine wind (Wireless or iTC-5 wired) sends data over SeaTalkNG. Missing data means masthead battery dead (wireless), no STNG sync, or iTC-5 misconfigured.

Sailors depend on wind data — if down, the plotter will also lose apparent/true wind calculations.

causes.cause: Wireless wind solar panel dirty or battery dead

fixSteps.title: Verify STNG bus
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure SeaTalkNG is up (other instruments working).

fixSteps.title: Check iTC-5
fixSteps.instruction: Verify LED status on the transducer interface.

fixSteps.title: Clean masthead panel
fixSteps.instruction: For Wireless Wind, clean solar panel — requires going up mast.

whenToCallPro: If masthead work is needed — requires rigger or bosun's chair.

faq.q: How long does Wireless Wind battery last?
faq.a: Solar-charged, no battery replacement — panel just needs to stay clean.

title: Evolution Autopilot Fault
shortDescription: EV-1 or EV-2 autopilot sensor has an error.
fullDescription:
Raymarine Evolution autopilots use an EV-1 CCU with a 9-axis solid-state compass. Faults include compass calibration loss (after installing new gear near CCU), power issues, or STNG sync loss.

Dockside calibration wizard must be rerun after major hardware changes.

fixSteps.title: Recalibrate compass
fixSteps.instruction: Run Swinging Compass calibration in calm water.

fixSteps.title: Check EV-1 location
fixSteps.instruction: Verify no new magnets or electronics within 3 ft.

fixSteps.title: Redo dockside setup
fixSteps.instruction: Full setup wizard for drive type and rudder limits.

whenToCallPro: If ACU needs replacement or drive unit has issues.

faq.a: Once at install, and any time major metal/magnets added near CCU.

title: Internal GPS Not Receiving
shortDescription: Axiom's internal GPS has no fix.
fullDescription:
Axiom has internal GPS; higher antennas (RS150) can be connected for better performance in covered cockpits. GPS fail means no fix on either.

Mount Axiom with clear view of sky above — metal biminis, hardtops, and below-deck mounts block reception.

fixSteps.title: Move to open sky
fixSteps.instruction: Relocate vessel out from under cover.

fixSteps.title: Add external RS150
fixSteps.instruction: Install external antenna on open sky location.

whenToCallPro: If internal GPS confirmed dead — Raymarine repair.

faq.q: Does RS150 help if Axiom is below?
faq.a: Yes — mount it on open deck/mast for far better reception.

title: Chart Cartridge Error
shortDescription: LightHouse, Navionics, or C-Map cartridge unreadable.
fullDescription:
Axiom reads charts from microSD slot. Errors occur from dirty card contacts, unsupported format, wrong slot (some Axioms have dual slots with different purposes), or failed subscription.

Swap the card into a computer to confirm it reads there before blaming the unit.

fixSteps.title: Try other slot
fixSteps.instruction: If dual-slot unit, try the other slot.

videoSearchQuery: Raymarine Axiom chart card not reading

faq.q: Can I use both LightHouse and Navionics?
faq.a: Yes — dual-slot Axioms support one of each.

title: AIS Receiver Not Responding
fullDescription:
Raymarine AIS units connect via SeaTalkNG and USB. AIS fail indicates bus sync loss or GPS antenna problem on the AIS itself (Class B transponders need their own GPS lock).

Check the AIS status via its web interface (USB to laptop) — this gives detailed diagnostics.

fixSteps.title: Check AIS LEDs
fixSteps.instruction: Green/red pattern per manual indicates health.

fixSteps.title: AIS web interface
fixSteps.instruction: USB to PC, open ProAIS2 for diagnostics.

whenToCallPro: If Class B transmitter needs MMSI change — dealer must reprogram.

faq.q: Can I change the MMSI myself?
faq.a: No — once programmed, only dealers or Raymarine can reprogram.

title: Display Backlight Issue
shortDescription: Axiom screen goes dark or flickers.
fullDescription:
Backlight issues on Axiom can be settings (auto-dim enabled with dirty ambient sensor) or hardware (failed LED driver). Direct sun baking can overheat the display and reduce backlight dimmer to protective level.

Check brightness menu first; if manual brightness maxed and screen still dim, hardware fault.

causes.cause: Auto-dim with dirty ambient light sensor

fixSteps.title: Clean ambient sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe front of unit with microfiber — sensor is usually a small hole.

whenToCallPro: If confirmed hardware backlight failure — Raymarine flat-rate repair.

faq.a: Yes over time — use sun cover when not in use.
